title: Console activation: micro‑training kits, technical handoff, and staged go‑live choreography
creator: Ava Chen
description: Deliver a concise, repeatable activation and technical handoff package for the Console UX features in this release (new dashboards, rollouts flows, and per-route cost breakdown). Package must include micro-training modules, runbooks for on-call and solutions engineers, templated release notes, and a staged go-live choreography with clear rollback criteria. Primary goal is to enable field/CS, onboarding, and internal SRE teams to confidently operate and explain feature behavior at GA.
goals: Produce three 10‑minute microtraining videos (product, ops, sales) and 1-page quick guides
Ship a templated release notes bundle for external comms and developer changelog
Define staging waves with monitoring and automatic fallback triggers
Complete technical handoff to SRE and Solutions within one sprint prior to GA
success_metrics: >80% enablement quiz pass rate for internal pilot cohort
Fewer than 3 support tickets per 1000 activations in first 30 days
No Sev incidents caused by rollout automation during staged waves
launch_timeline: 2026-03-20: Pilot with two existing customers (limited data exposure)
2026-03-27: Wider internal beta + public release notes draft ready
2026-04-03: Staged activation wave 1 (10% traffic for console customers)
rollout_waves: Wave 0 - Internal: product, SRE, sales dry-run
Wave 1 - Pilot customers: opt-in via support ticket
Wave 2 - Select tenancy groups: customers with dedicated/enterprise plans
Wave 3 - Broad opt-in: all customers with console access
Wave 4 - Force enable: GA default for new signups
rollback_plan: Immediate soft-failover to previous rollout shard (route-level toggle). If error rate > 3% or latency regression > 150ms sustained for 5m, trigger Wave rollback (automated via infra toggle). Escalation: notify SRE and PM, open incident in PagerDuty. Post-rollback checklist includes isolating commit range, reverting rollout flag, and a postmortem within 72 hours.
acceptance_criteria: All three microtraining videos published and linked in Confluence
Ops runbook reviewed and approved by SRE
Release notes reviewed by legal and marketing
Rollout automation tested in staging with simulated load
Pilot customers completed and provided feedback; critical fixes triaged
